title: Expression conformance case
description: One case of the shared jq expression conformance corpus (ADR 0014 Decision 5). See README.md.

name.description: <area>/<file name without .yaml>. Unique across the corpus; divergence lists refer to it.

test.description: The test name a runner reports the case under, givenX_whenY_thenZ. Unique across the corpus.

area.description: The coverage area, equal to the case's directory.

summary.description: What the case proves, in one sentence.

source.description: Where the expected result comes from: ADR 0012 Decision 9, ADR 0014 Decision 3 or 5 (plus the gojq README), a data-flow corpus case, or a v1 test file:line.

engine.description: What an engine does with the expression, when that matters (for example a builtin it does not implement).

expression.description: The jq expression, bare or wrapped in ${ }. Always a single-quoted YAML scalar.

input.description: The value bound to `.`. Required; may be null.

variables.description: Values bound to $<name>. A declared variable left out is null.

result.description: The first output, or null when the expression has none.

truthy.description: False for null and false, true for everything else.

phase.description: compile: fails before any evaluation. evaluate: fails while evaluating.

detailContains.description: Strings the fault detail must contain, such as the blocked builtin. May be empty when only the phase is specified.
